title: Revolution—Not Evolution: Detangling tokenization of RWAs
author: Sandy Kaul, Franklin Templeton
key_passages: Synthetic exposure tokens: Token holders do not possess ownership rights, nor investor protections linked to the underlying assets. Instead, the token holder owns shares of a special purpose vehicle
Digitally native RWA tokens: Token holders are the official owners of the RWA and, as such, they get the full ownership rights including voting rights
Digital twin tokens: ownership of the asset is awarded and recorded in traditional, off-chain form
relevance: Legal structure and holder rights for RWA tokens - three distinct models.
